description: A null default of type any added to a map of lists makes every attribute unknown
notes: The README says defaults populate missing optional attributes, so the result should be the list given for a and the null default for b, and the spec says an operation returns an unknown value only if an operand is unknown. hashicorp/hcl's Defaults.apply unifies the map's elements with the added default (unifyAsMap in ext/typeexpr/defaults.go), a list of strings with the dynamic pseudo-type; go-cty unifies those to the dynamic pseudo-type with conversions that replace every value with the dynamic value (unifyAllAsDynamic, called from unifyCollectionTypes in cty/convert/unify.go), so both attributes become unknown. The test also needs any in a type constraint with defaults (native/type-expressions/any-with-defaults).
